scope: published HTML/CSS/JS, asset metadata, deterministic browser measurements, and optional PageSpeed/Lighthouse results

rules.title: Published site is accessible
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please make sure the published template URL is accessible before resubmitting.

rules.title: No legacy Webflow IX2 interactions
rules.calibration_note: The 2026-05-26 expanded calibration sample found approved Good outcomes with current published-site IX2 evidence. Confirm policy scope, exception model, and reviewed-state snapshot behavior before exposing this as automatic hard-blocker language.
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please rebuild legacy IX2 interactions using current Webflow Interactions powered by GSAP/IX3, republish the site, and resubmit.

rules.title: Licenses page exists and is linked
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please add a visible footer link to the Licenses page and ensure the page includes the required licensing language.

rules.title: Utility pages that require noindex include noindex metadata
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please add a noindex robots meta tag to utility pages that should not appear in search results.

rules.title: No placeholder or default Webflow text remains
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please replace placeholder or default Webflow text with finished template content.

rules.title: Homepage SEO title follows template format
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please set the homepage SEO title to the required Webflow template title format.

rules.title: Each primary page has one H1
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please update heading structure so each primary page has one clear H1.

rules.title: Heading levels follow a logical hierarchy
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please fix heading hierarchy so headings progress in a logical order without skipped levels.

rules.title: Important images have alt text or decorative handling
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please add alt text for important images or mark decorative images appropriately.

rules.title: Form fields have accessible labels
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please add visible labels or appropriate ARIA labels for all form inputs.

rules.title: Internal links resolve successfully
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please fix broken internal links before resubmitting.

rules.title: No horizontal overflow on standard viewports
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please fix horizontal overflow so the layout reflows without side scrolling across standard viewport widths.

rules.title: Assets avoid extreme file sizes
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please resize or compress oversized image assets to improve template performance.

rules.title: CSS fixed-height density is a responsive quality proxy
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please review fixed-height layout patterns that may reduce responsive flexibility.

rules.title: Interactive elements have hover or focus state coverage
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please confirm that clickable elements have clear hover and focus states.

rules.title: PageSpeed or Lighthouse scores are captured for rubric calibration
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please improve PageSpeed and Lighthouse scores for SEO, performance, best practices, and accessibility.

rules.title: Primary conversion routes are discoverable
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please make primary calls to action easy to find and repeat them in high-traffic areas where appropriate.

rules.title: Page layouts show meaningful structural variety
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please add more meaningful layout variety between pages where the current structures are too repetitive.

rules.title: Visual style feels outdated or insufficiently differentiated
rules.calibration_note: Frequent in rejected feedback, but reviewer phrasing varies. Use normalized sub-buckets and proxy evidence; do not auto-reject on this signal in Phase 1.
rules.creator_feedback_template: Please refresh the visual direction so the template better aligns with current marketplace expectations for typography, color, layout variety, asset cohesion, and category differentiation.
